ops.oldText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit, hire, or employ any Vendor employee during the term or for twenty-four months afterward, regardless of how the employee applies.
ops.newText: 12.4 Customer shall not solicit any Vendor employee during the term or for 12 months afterward.

ops.text: This restriction is mutual: neither party shall solicit personnel of the other party, and Section 12.4 is limited to personnel directly involved in the Services and runs for 12 months from the end of that individual's involvement in the Services rather than from the end of the term. Neither party is restricted from hiring a person who responds to a general advertisement or other general recruitment activity not targeted at the other party's personnel, or who makes an unsolicited approach to a party, and neither party is subject to any no-hire obligation.

proposal.comment: [Playbook] We deleted the no-hire limbs ("hire, or employ" and "regardless of how the employee applies") and cut the period to 12 months, then added one sentence making the restriction expressly mutual, limiting it to personnel directly involved in the Services for 12 months from the end of their involvement, and carving out general advertisements and unsolicited approaches. A no-hire covering all Vendor employees for 24 months is walk-away for us and contradicts § 12.3; deleting § 12.4 entirely also works.
proposal.summary: Cut § 12.4 to a 12-month non-solicit with no no-hire, and add one sentence making it expressly mutual, limited to personnel directly involved in the Services measured from the end of involvement, with general-advertisement and unsolicited-approach carve-outs.

mappings.element: Non-solicit limited to personnel directly involved in the Services.
Non-solicit limited to 12 months from the end of their involvement.
